_source: Grace's existing communion mechanic, congregation-facing. Connor's verbatim spec, recorded on Trackers/Action-Logs/Connor - Build slides to guide the 8-30 Sunday-night planning lunch-Log.md: 'the greeters at the doors are in charge of handing out communion and ushers are in charge of distributing it to folks who raise their hand mid service', corrected 2026-08-22 to 'the mid service communion distribution is only to catch folks who never got it on the way in, so technically the answer is both'. The Formation-deck slide that carried this was staff-facing ('GREETERS TAKE THE DOOR. USHERS TAKE THE ROOM.'); this one is written for the room instead. No liturgy or words of institution invented -- the vault records none.
lines: Missed it on the way in?
Raise your hand and we’ll bring it to you.
